subject: maths
question: After the division of a number successively by 2,3 and 5, the remainders are 1,2 and 3, respectively. What will be the remainder, if 13 divides the same number (if the last quotient is 1)?
solution:
Formula used:

Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder

Calculation:

The number X in this case will be determined as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/094f88ff4669a639d7450698e4eec2aa60aa44eb0b9392bc6f96a1dfd8b98214.png] 
We know that, Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder

Z = (5 × 1) + 3 = 8

Y = (3 × Z) + 2 = (3 × 8) + 2 = 26

X = (2 × Y) + 1 = (2 × 26) + 1 = 53

∴ X = 53

According to question,

When (X) is divided by 13 i.e. (53)/(13), then the remainder will be 1.

∴ Remainder of (53)/(13) = 1.
